rationale: The plan matches the reference: filter, median-of-ratios normalization, log2 matrix, UCell rank-based per-sample scores over the versioned Hallmark collection with per-set gene coverage recorded and low-overlap sets flagged, then limma with a two-group condition design and BH across the 50 signatures, plus a leave-one-out sensitivity for sample_01 rather than silent removal. QC is complete and design-specific (vst blind PCA, distance heatmap, library size and detected genes for sample_01 against the median, explicit keep policy). Weaknesses: the design formula and reference level are only implied by the stated contrast direction rather than written out; no alpha is stated for BH; the effect on UCell scores is labelled 'log2FC' rather than a difference of mean scores; and eBayes trend/robust settings for a score matrix are not mentioned.
